target_roles.title: Director of Product Marketing
target_roles.rationale: As a printer manufacturer serving the signage and graphics industry, Epson's Product Marketing leadership is critical because they define the complete solution story that their customers (sign shops, wrap installers, graphics companies) present to end users. This role owns competitive differentiation and solution positioning for the SureColor product lines. By partnering with Tedlar, they can enhance their value proposition with a proven protective film solution that extends the outdoor lifespan of prints to 12-20+ years—directly addressing end-customer concerns about durability, UV resistance, and warranty claims. This role benefits from: (1) Stronger competitive positioning against Roland, HP, and Mimaki by offering a complete, premium durability solution; (2) Reduced customer complaints about print degradation by recommending Tedlar overlaminates in their application guides; (3) Enhanced customer success stories demonstrating superior ROI through reduced replacement cycles; (4) Co-marketing opportunities at ISA Sign Expo and PRINTING United where Epson maintains major presence. Given Epson's recent SureColor S9170 launch and continuous product innovation, Product Marketing needs premium material partnerships to differentiate their solutions in the outdoor signage, vehicle wrap, and architectural graphics segments where durability is the primary customer concern.

target_roles.title: VP of Business Development
target_roles.rationale: Epson's Business Development leadership drives strategic partnerships, channel programs, and ecosystem relationships that expand market reach and customer value. This role is critical because Tedlar represents a high-value strategic partnership opportunity rather than a transactional sale—Epson doesn't consume protective films, but they influence specifications and purchasing decisions across thousands of sign shops, wrap installers, and graphics companies using their printers. This executive would care about Tedlar partnership because: (1) Joint go-to-market programs create stickiness with Epson's customer base by offering complete print-to-protection workflows; (2) Co-branded durability programs differentiate Epson solutions in competitive bids where end-customers demand 10+ year outdoor performance guarantees; (3) Technical integration opportunities (application guides, lamination profiles, certification programs) increase Epson printer utilization and consumables pull-through; (4) Access to Tedlar's distribution network (protective film converters and distributors) opens new sales channels for Epson equipment. Given Epson's #1 market position in dye-sublimation and UV flatbed printing, Business Development owns the strategic agenda for maintaining leadership through ecosystem partnerships that solve complete customer workflows—from substrate to ink to protection—rather than selling equipment alone.

target_roles.title: Director of Product Management
target_roles.rationale: Epson's Product Management team owns the SureColor roadmap, application specifications, and technical recommendations that their customers rely on for material compatibility and workflow optimization. This role is essential because they create the technical documentation, application guides, and certification programs that specify which laminates and protective films work optimally with Epson inks and substrates. They would care about Tedlar partnership because: (1) Product quality and customer satisfaction metrics improve when they can recommend a proven protective solution that prevents the UV fading, cracking, and color degradation that leads to warranty claims and customer complaints; (2) Competitive benchmarking shows that complete solutions (printer + ink + protection) win more deals in the premium outdoor graphics segment where municipalities, transit agencies, and fleet operators demand 10-15+ year durability guarantees; (3) Technical collaboration on lamination profiles and application parameters reduces customer trial-and-error, accelerating time-to-production for new SureColor buyers; (4) Product line strategy benefits from validated use cases demonstrating Epson+Tedlar combinations outperforming competitive solutions in harsh outdoor environments. Given Epson's emphasis on same-day lamination capability and immediate scratch resistance in their vehicle wrap and outdoor signage marketing, Product Management needs validated protective film partnerships to substantiate these durability claims with real-world performance data and customer case studies.
